claims.claim: A budget is a spending plan that assigns income to expenses, saving and other priorities. Start from after-tax income for cash planning, distinguish committed and discretionary costs, and include irregular items. A balance sheet separately lists what is owned and owed at a specific date. For a budget, subtract planned outflows from inflows; a deficit calls for review of options, not a moral judgement. Some expenses cannot be reduced without harm. Financial hardship may warrant free independent support.
